investigations.title: Operation DarkVault: APT Exfiltration & Ransomware Staging
investigations.description: Suspected advanced persistent threat targeting financial database servers via compromised VPN credentials. Memory captures and disk images seized from primary domain controller.

investigations.title: Apex Dynamics Intellectual Property Theft & Trade Secrets
investigations.description: Unauthorized extraction of proprietary aeronautics design files onto unencrypted NVMe flash storage prior to senior research scientist departure.

investigations.title: Vortex Capital Swift Wire Transfer Fraud
investigations.description: Manipulated payment authorization gateway logs resulting in $4.2M fraudulent overseas routing. Packet captures and server logs acquired.
investigations.closureSummary: Perpetrators identified and prosecuted. Restitution and court proceedings finalized.

evidence.description: Physical RAM dump of infected Primary Domain Controller (WIN-DC01.FIN.LOCAL)
evidence.collectionLocation: Primary Data Center, Server Rack 4-B, Chicago IL
evidence.acquisitionNotes: Acquired using hardware write-blocked PCIe capture card directly into encrypted storage container. Host remained isolated from external WAN.

evidence.description: Full packet capture of lateral movement and staging channel traffic (Port 443 TCP)
evidence.sourceDevice: Cisco Nexus 9300 Core Switch SPAN Port
evidence.acquisitionNotes: Continuous passive fiber optic tap. Zero packet loss confirmed via CRC check registers.

evidence.description: Physical bit-stream image of suspect SanDisk Extreme PRO 1TB NVMe Solid State Drive
evidence.collectionLocation: Suspect Residence, Private Office, San Jose CA
evidence.acquisitionNotes: Seized pursuant to Search Warrant #2026-SW-088. Imaged using Tableau T8u Forensic USB 3.0 Bridge with hardware write-protection engaged.

evidence.description: Sanitized transaction ledger and gateway authorization server logs
evidence.acquisitionNotes: Exported directly from immutable CloudWatch log group with signed AWS SigV4 cryptographic receipt.
